about: The screen sizes the scripts capture and check at. lib/viewports.ts is the only reader of this file. 'pane', 'desktop', 'phone' and 'preview' are the sizes the review and capture scripts use. 'real' is a snapshot of the site's PostHog viewport sizes, taken on the date in 'taken'; no script refreshes it. 'edges' are the outer limits from published standards and device classes. scripts/hero-check.ts checks that each page's first screen fits every size in 'real', 'edges' and 'preview'.

pane.why: Jager's browser pane, measured from his tab (innerWidth x innerHeight) on 2026-10-10; he resizes it, so measure again before a review; shots and scene-check review at it

desktop.why: desktop review size used by scene-check, shots, space-frames and article covers

phone.why: phone review size used by scene-check, shots, space-frames and article covers

preview.why: link preview and live card frame; article covers and share images are captured at it

edges.why: smallest phone still in use; WCAG 1.4.10 reflow width
